newsitem.title: USA: CHRYSLER GETS $232 MLN TAX BREAK IN OHIO-NYT.
newsitem.headline: CHRYSLER GETS $232 MLN TAX BREAK IN OHIO-NYT.

text.p: Chrysler Corp won $232 million of tax breaks and other government incentives for building a Jeep assembly plant in Toledo, Ohio, the New York Times reported.
The plant will employ 4,900 workers -- 600 fewer than the existing plant in Toledo, the paper said.
Still, local officials said the area would have been financially devastated if Chrysler had decided to relocate.
The company will spend $600 million to build and equip the new factory and another $600 million to refurbish an existing building on the site, the paper said.
